Interface DBStatementBase

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Subinterfaces:
DBPreparedStatement, DBStatement
public interface DBStatementBase extends AutoCloseable
The methods shared by DBStatement and DBPreparedStatement.

Unlike JDBC, where a prepared statement extends a statement and inherits methods it must not call, both statements extend this common root, so each one only has the methods it can use.

Author:
Miquel Sas

    • setFetchSize

      void setFetchSize(int rows) throws SQLException
      Sets the number of rows fetched from the database each time more rows are needed, a hint to read large result sets without loading them whole in memory. Some drivers, like PostgreSQL, only apply it with auto-commit off.
      Parameters:
      rows - The number of rows, or 0 to leave the choice to the driver.
      Throws:
      SQLException - If an error occurs.
